name: parse-text
title: Parse Text
description: Parse and transform the selected text (or the clipboard, if nothing is selected). Currently unwraps links that a line-wrap split across lines; more text transforms to come.
author: sujha

commands.name: parse-text
commands.title: Parse Text
commands.subtitle: Selection or Clipboard
commands.description: Parse the current selection, or the clipboard when nothing is selected. When the text is a URL wrapped across lines, join it back into a single line first.
